projects.name: Company Citicorp Services India Pvt. Ltd.
details: Company Citicorp Services India Pvt. Ltd.
Details: Acted as pioneer UAT team member in the alert migration project. Contributed significantly to the successful validation
and optimization of the new surveillance framework. Demonstrated strong ownership by proactively engaging in early stage
testing of alert logic and data flows during migration phase. Provided actionable observation to manager and product owners
improving visibility to system gaps & potential risk areas which further facilitated effective collaboration across stakehold ers
and ensured timely enhancements to the alert design and configuration. The identification of improvement opportunities in alert
calibration helped refining trigger logic and filter mechanism which directly led to reduction in false positive alerts
